label: MEASURED
scope: Target-neutral XAX semantic transactions used by the JVM row, measured on five paired local structural edits against C-like textual source.

protocol.token_source: final total_token_usage recorded by the Codex session

limits: Five small local edits only; creation, control-flow, repair, stale-root, cross-function/API, context-scaling, and large-application task classes were not part of this run.
One model, one reasoning setting, and one trial per cell; no significance claim.
The textual arm is C-like source, not Java or Kotlin source; the measured XAX workspace protocol is target-neutral and no backend build occurs inside an edit cell.

A preflight session was excluded before the registered run because its sandbox denied every file-discovery command; it produced no completed turn or token record and left the first workspace unchanged.
